g.text: KEYS: two electrical contacts per MX switch; either orientation. Enable INPUT_PULLUP on all keys, encoder A/B and push inputs.

g.desc: KEYS: two electrical contacts per MX switch; either orientation. Enable INPUT_PULLUP on all keys, encoder A/B and push inputs.

g.text: ENCODERS: passive mechanical A/B/C + isolated push switch. Join C and SW2 locally to GND; 4 wires per encoder module.

g.desc: ENCODERS: passive mechanical A/B/C + isolated push switch. Join C and SW2 locally to GND; 4 wires per encoder module.

g.text: Use 2.54 mm solder headers or prewired keyed plugs. Keep GND with each cable. Insulate solder joints and add strain relief.

g.desc: Use 2.54 mm solder headers or prewired keyed plugs. Keep GND with each cable. Insulate solder joints and add strain relief.

g.text: REFERENCE BOARD ONLY: check exact clone schematic before wiring. No PCB footprint or manufacturing pinout is implied here.

g.desc: REFERENCE BOARD ONLY: check exact clone schematic before wiring. No PCB footprint or manufacturing pinout is implied here.

g.text: No matrix, diodes or external pull-ups in minimum build. Firmware debounce required. Optional 100 nF from each ADC input to GND.

g.desc: No matrix, diodes or external pull-ups in minimum build. Firmware debounce required. Optional 100 nF from each ADC input to GND.

g.text: USB: PC -> board native USB/OTG socket. GPIO19 and GPIO20 reserved. UART-only USB socket cannot carry our HID reports.

g.desc: USB: PC -> board native USB/OTG socket. GPIO19 and GPIO20 reserved. UART-only USB socket cannot carry our HID reports.

g.text: JOYSTICK: 3.3 V analog assumption ONLY. Flex pin count/order/pitch and click are UNVERIFIED. No physical FPC pin assignment.

g.desc: JOYSTICK: 3.3 V analog assumption ONLY. Flex pin count/order/pitch and click are UNVERIFIED. No physical FPC pin assignment.

g.text: CONNECTIONS: identical net labels are electrically connected. Pin names are functional markings, NOT physical header positions.

g.desc: CONNECTIONS: identical net labels are electrically connected. Pin names are functional markings, NOT physical header positions.

g.text: Four-wire stick: leave GPIO21 unconnected, disable its action; SW5 is left click. Five-wire breakout: click may also use GPIO21.

g.desc: Four-wire stick: leave GPIO21 unconnected, disable its action; SW5 is left click. Five-wire breakout: click may also use GPIO21.

g.text: 8 MX keys + 2 push encoders + analog mouse stick / one native USB cable

g.desc: 8 MX keys + 2 push encoders + analog mouse stick / one native USB cable
